title: Live: Trump pushes to expand 'Board of Peace', challenging UN Security Council
summary: US President Donald Trump pushed to expand his new “Board of Peace” beyond Gaza during the World Economic Forum’s annual meeting in Davos, signaling a direct attempt to bypass the UN Security Council. contentText: NATO chief Mark Rutte denied on Thursday reports that Greenland’s sovereignty had been compromised during his talks with US President Donald Trump over the president’s push to acquire the autonomous Danish island.  According to reports, Rutte’s  “creative solution” to appease Trump included handing the US sovereignty over the Pituffik military base and the possibility of more in the future. Follow our liveblog for all developments.
